title: 用修改成本说明耦合
premise: 现有行为边界已明确，团队收集维护痛点，不先选框架。
listeningTask: 识别真正的耦合证据和不属于本轮的问题。

lines.en: There's hidden coupling through the global client. Testing formatting currently requires a network connection.
lines.zh: 全局客户端造成隐藏耦合，测格式化目前还需要联网。

lines.en: That's a concrete reason to separate boundaries. Which changes have the highest recurring cost?
lines.zh: 这是拆边界的具体理由，哪些修改反复成本最高？

lines.en: Filtering changes touch fetching and rendering together. Just to confirm, separating those helps, right?
lines.zh: 筛选修改会同时碰取数和渲染，确认一下，拆开会有帮助，对吧？

lines.en: Okay, our bandwidth covers two engineers this sprint. Maybe three days go to test discovery.
lines.zh: 好，本迭代只有两名工程师投入，测试梳理可能花三天。

lines.en: A characterization test will expose those dependencies. Use injected test clients instead of real calls.
lines.zh: 现有行为测试能暴露这些依赖，用注入测试客户端，不发真实请求。

lines.en: One action item is removing import-time requests. Importing the module shouldn't start a job.
lines.zh: 一项任务是移除导入时请求，导入模块不应启动作业。

lines.en: Good, but keep credential handling unchanged externally. Internal separation doesn't authorize a security redesign.
lines.zh: 好，但外部凭据处理保持不变，内部拆分不代表授权安全重设计。

lines.en: Let's take it offline for framework comparisons. First agree on the behavior we must preserve.
lines.zh: 框架对比会后聊，先同意必须保留的行为。

lines.en: We'll measure isolated test runtime as evidence. Faster tests are useful, not the sole goal.
lines.zh: 记录隔离测试耗时，测试更快有用但不是唯一目标。

lines.en: Agreed, unchanged reports matter more to consumers. I'll collect the command-line invocation examples today.
lines.zh: 同意，使用方更重视报表不变，今天收集命令行调用样例。

scene: 现有行为边界已明确，团队收集维护痛点，不先选框架。
accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）
